pattern: ^\[Win32App\]\[ExecutionActionHandler\] Encountered early subgraph termination\. Clearing GRS for app with id: {GUID} so it can be retried during the next check-in\.
description: IME aborted the app's subgraph before enforcement finished and cleared its GRS entry so the app retries on the next check-in (ExecutionActionHandler, AppWorkload.log). Maps to Postponed: the install did not complete this pass but is scheduled to run again - previously this looked like an unexplained gap. Wording verified in IME 1.97 and 1.104.
